title: rosa rubiginosa var. flagellaris
intro: Rosa rubiginosa var. flagellaris, commonly known as the Downy Rose or Flagellar Rose, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia, characterized by its fragrant pink flowers and thorny branches. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rubiginosa var. flagellaris include its ability to calm the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fragrances, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
